ActionDef.description: ActionDef represents a complete action definition loaded from an embedded JSON file under data/actions/<platform>/<TYPE>.json.

$schema.description: Schema is the editor "$schema" pointer; ignored at run time.

actionType.description: Action name; must equal the file name without .json.

automation.description: Automation is the owning package id; Platform is the legacy alias.

description.description: What the action does, in one or two sentences.

inputs.description: Inputs; the workflow node form is generated from them.

loops.description: Id-based loops over a list variable (for_each is the inline alternative).

metadata.description: Free-form flags, e.g. requiresAuth, supportsPagination, supportsRetry.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of one output item.

outputs.description: Output field names by outcome, e.g. {"success": ["url"], "failure": ["error"]}.

platform.description: Legacy owning platform (upper case). New actions set automation instead.

provenance.description: Provenance records how the action was made (e.g. a recording id).

sideEffects.description: SideEffects is the action's strongest effect: none | read | write | message | destructive.

steps.description: Steps, run in order. Steps named by a condition's then/else or a loop run only from there.

ConditionDef.description: ConditionDef describes a conditional expression for condition steps.

ErrorHandlerDef.description: ErrorHandlerDef describes the error handling policy for a single step.

action.description: What to do when the step fails.

onFailure.description: Action after the retries are used up.

GlobalErrorConfig.description: GlobalErrorConfig defines top-level error handling policy for the entire action.

onFinalFailure.description: What to do after the last retry fails.

InputDef.description: InputDef lists the required and optional input variables for an action. Both fields accept either an array of strings (legacy) or an array of objects with {name, type, description, ...} (current format).

default.description: Value used when the input is not given.

format.description: Value format hint, e.g. email, uri.

name.description: Variable name, used as {{name}} in step templates.

options.description: Allowed values for a select input.

ui.description: Form hints; forms are generated from inputs.

default.description: Value used when the input is not given.

format.description: Value format hint, e.g. email, uri.

name.description: Variable name, used as {{name}} in step templates.

options.description: Allowed values for a select input.

ui.description: Form hints; forms are generated from inputs.

LoopDef.description: LoopDef defines an iteration over a collection of items, executing a subset of the action's steps for each item. NOTE: a legacy "onComplete" field appears in some shipped loop JSONs. It is deliberately NOT modeled here — it was historically parsed but never executed, so json.Unmarshal now silently ignores it for JSON compatibility.

iterator.description: Variable holding the list to iterate.

maxItemsPerDay.description: MaxItemsPerDay is an optional template (e.g. "{{maxFollowsPerDay or 150}}") resolving to a cross-run daily cap, persisted in the action_daily_counters table and keyed by (profile, action type, UTC day). Unlike MaxItems (a per-session, in-memory cap), this cap survives across separate action runs on the same day.

steps.description: Step ids run for each item.

StepDef.description: StepDef represents a single step in an action definition.

action.description: Action is the call_action reference ("<action>" or "<automation>.<action>").

alternatives.description: Fallback CSS selectors tried in order.

as.description: for_each: name of the item variable (default "item").

condition.description: condition: a ConditionDef object or an expression string.

configKey.description: Name of a selectors.json entry (tried after xpath and selector).

dataSource.description: save_data / update_progress: variable holding the data.

elementRef.description: Variable holding an element found by an earlier step (a find_element step id or variable_name).

else.description: condition: step ids to run when false.

fields.description: Fields maps output field → sub-selector for extract_table / extract_list-style steps (relative to each row/item).

humanLike.description: Type and move like a person (jittered delays).

id.description: Step id, unique within the action.

input.description: Input is the source template for transform; Ops its operations.

inputs.description: Inputs are the variables passed to call_fragment / call_action / page_script (values are templates).

intent.description: Intent describes the step's target element in plain words (e.g. "the chat's Send button"). It is only used by the opt-in Jev fallback (jevfallback.go) when the step's selector/xpath finds nothing; a step without an intent never falls back.

items.description: Items is the for_each list template; As names the item variable (default "item"); Steps is the inline loop body.

key.description: Key is the key for press_key ("Enter", "Escape", "Control+a", ...).

onError.description: What to do when the step fails.

onSuccess.description: What to do when the step succeeds.

path.description: Path is a JSON path ("a.b[0].c") for extract_json.

raceSelectors.description: find_element: label → selector; the first present wins and its label is stored.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element.

sideEffect.description: SideEffect marks a step that writes, sends or deletes on the site. Safe-mode verification (SetSafeMode) stops before the first one.

text.description: Text to type (template), or text to match.

then.description: condition: step ids to run when true.

until.description: Until is a post-step outcome to wait for (click/type/submit), and the condition of a wait_for step.

url.description: navigate: target URL (template). Must be inside site.domains.

variable.description: Variable the step reads or writes.

variable_name.description: Variable the step's result is stored in.

waitAfter.description: Seconds to wait after the step.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before the step runs.

xpath.description: XPath of the target element (tried before selector).

SuccessAction.description: SuccessAction defines what happens when a step succeeds.

TransformOp.description: TransformOp is one operation of a transform step, applied in order to the list (or single object) the step's Input resolves to. map Map: {newField: "{{template over the item}}"} filter Where: condition evaluated against each item dedupe Field: key field (whole item when empty) regex_extract Field, Pattern (first capture group, else whole match), To parse_date Field, Layout (Go layout, or "auto"), To (RFC3339 output) parse_number Field, To ("1.2k" → 1200, "3,400" → 3400) join Field (list field), Sep, To split Field, Sep, To pick Fields: keep only these keys limit Count

map.description: map: new field → template over the item.

to.description: Field the result is written to (default: field).

where.description: filter: condition evaluated against each item.

WaitSpec.description: WaitSpec is the condition of a wait_for step, or a step's "until" outcome. Exactly one of the leaf fields, or Any (first match wins).

any.description: Any of these conditions (first match wins).

networkIdle.description: No network requests for a short while.

urlMatches.description: Go regexp against the page URL

description: One action of an automation package: inputs, outputs and the steps the action engine runs.
